cards.title: Crankshaft
cards.body: We inspect and measure the crankshaft for wear and damage as part of every rebuild.

cards.title: Cylinder Head
cards.body: The cylinder head is inspected and measured to ensure it meets original specification.

cards.title: VANOS Components
cards.body: VANOS components are inspected and recalibrated as standard during rebuild.

cards.title: Oil Pump
cards.body: The oil pump is inspected and measured to confirm it's delivering correct pressure.
